project.purpose: Provide optional cross-provider effect-safety/reference profiles only where direct provider/client semantics leave a demonstrated gap.

nodes.label: EffectIntent
nodes.responsibility: Bind one exact provider/account/effect/payload occurrence before effect admission.

nodes.label: EffectAuthority
nodes.responsibility: Translate exact operator approval into bounded effect authority independent of reusable credentials.
nodes.authority: Distribution authority translator + external policy owner
acceptance: No write is admitted without exact current authority binding.

nodes.label: ProviderExecutor
nodes.responsibility: Invoke mature provider-native execution substrates after policy admission.

nodes.label: ProviderReadback
nodes.responsibility: Observe provider-native object identity/state after attempted effects.
mustNotOwn: local Runtime success as provider truth
acceptance: Provider acceptance is established only from provider-native readback/evidence.

nodes.label: Reconciliation
nodes.responsibility: Classify safe retry, no-retry, or unresolved outcomes without duplicating ambiguous effects.
acceptance: Ambiguous external outcomes are not blindly replayed.

slices.objective: Keep provider writes blocked until exact release/effect authority and provider-native safe-retry conditions are simultaneously satisfied.
acceptance: No provider write occurs from connectivity/test success alone; any future write produces exact authority and readback evidence.
blockers: Current write authority/release standing remains blocked by owner evidence.
slices.nextAction: Re-evaluate only when a real release/effect owner supplies exact authority.

gaps: Real provider-write coverage remains intentionally authority-gated.

review.notes: R8 Temporal and R10 Steam preflight forward executable surfaces retired after zero external executable-consumer census. D01-D05 remain under natural-owner substitution review.

sharedCatalog.note: Optional shared coordinates only; project-native semantics remain authoritative.
